redFlags.reason: Inhibits intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme, significantly raising blood drug concentration and elevating risk of muscle damage (rhabdomyolysis).
Contains naturally occurring lovastatin; co-ingestion multiplies dosage and toxic strain on the liver.

depletions.advice: Statins block the mevalonate pathway, reducing endogenous CoQ10. Consider 100-200mg CoQ10 daily with meals if experiencing muscle fatigue.

redFlags.reason: Alcohol potentiates metformin's effect on lactate metabolism, markedly increasing the danger of lactic acidosis.

depletions.advice: Long-term metformin usage impairs ileal B12 absorption. Annual serum B12 testing or methylcobalamin supplementation is advised.

redFlags.reason: Significantly binds free thyroxine in the gut, compromising therapeutic absorption.

timingRules.rule: Take Levothyroxine first thing in the morning on an empty stomach; separate from Calcium, Iron, and Multivitamins by at least 4 hours.

redFlags.reason: Vitamin K directly reverses warfarin's anticoagulant mechanism, elevating blood clot risks.

redFlags.item: High-Dose Fish Oil / Ginkgo / Garlic Extract
redFlags.reason: Additively inhibits platelet aggregation, considerably elevating spontaneous bleeding risks.
ACE inhibitors reduce aldosterone secretion, causing potassium retention. Salt substitutes containing potassium chloride can trigger dangerous hyperkalemia.

depletions.advice: ACE inhibitors can increase urinary zinc excretion; monitor dietary intake of pumpkin seeds, oysters, or modest zinc supplementation.

redFlags.reason: Oxalic acid binds free calcium into insoluble calcium oxalate, rendering it unabsorbable and increasing kidney stone burden.

timingRules.rule: Competes directly for divalent metal transporters (DMT-1). Separate calcium from iron supplements by at least 2 to 3 hours.
